form:FormGroup.label: Key Store Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Choose the key store type, e.g. JKS, PKCS12

form:FormGroup.label: Key Store File Path
form:FormGroup.helpText: The absolute path of the key store file, e.g. one kept up to date by a key manager such as cert-manager. The file must be at this path on every node, in a directory an administrator has allowed with stroom.credentials.allowedKeyStoreFileDirs. The file is used where it is, so changes to it are picked up without changing these credentials, within about 10 minutes (stroom.pipeline.httpClientCache.refreshAfterWrite).

form:FormGroup.label: Key Store Pass Phrase (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Enter a key store pass phrase to unlock the keystore if one is required
